annotations.title: Forever market value for one item

description: Market value, minimum buyout, historical value and units listed for one item on one WoW: Forever realm, from full auction scans players started and uploaded. A day is public after 3 reporters (distinct upload addresses) scanned the item; values are medians, thin days and outlier days are left out of the market value. Market value weights the last 14 public days, historical is the median of 60. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.
name: market_value

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

market.description: Null when no solid public day falls in the last 14: unrecorded, not zero.

value.description: Null until 3 reporters scanned the item on the realm.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.
